Name: Upper Beth-horon
Description: Upper Beth-horon was the upper of the two Beth-horons, a border town of Ephraim and a fortified city rebuilt by Solomon, on the ascent where God threw down hailstones on the Amorites.
BiblicalSignificance: Upper Beth-horon, with its lower town, guards the famous ascent: the road of Joshua's victory and Solomon's fortification.
